## Planets

The [planets](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Planet) of the [Solar System](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solar_System), in order from the **Sun**:

<!-- next block -->

| Planet | Distance (AU) | Moons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Mercury](<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercury_(planet)>) | 0.39 | 0 |
| [Venus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Venus) | 0.72 | 0 |
| [Earth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Earth) | 1.00 | 1 |

Each planet keeps its own orbit.
